caption:
Me taking a ten minute nap

Me taking a ten minute nap.

A nap past about 30 minutes often leaves you groggier than before. Short and early in the afternoon works best.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left, closes its eyes and starts to doze, sinking a little more each time a digital clock on the right jumps from 2:00 to 2:10, 2:50, 3:30, 4:10 and 5:00, with little zz bubbles. In the last seconds the text changes from: me taking a ten minute nap, to: ten minutes ago: three hours. Its eyes snap wide open and it trembles, then it narrows its eyes at the camera.
